verdict.rationale: Ubuntu Desktop is itself a free, open-source, self-hostable OS that users install on their own hardware, replacing or dual-booting existing systems, with full package archive access and free Ubuntu Pro tier — inherently satisfying self-hosting for an AI-native user. missing for 10: no explicit AI-native-specific self-hosting guidance, no independent verification of ease-of-self-hosting for AI workloads, and docs-probe endpoints (llms.txt, openapi) all 404 suggesting weaker AI-native tooling support.
